nodes.speaker: Distant voice
nodes.text: Yes, you! Orientation started ages ago. Over here, quickly!

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: ...Orientation? Does the afterlife have an orientation?

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Well, I don't have any better ideas. Probably best to do what they say.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: There you are! Do you have any idea what time it is?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: I'm Professor Kepler, and you are already late to orientation. On your very first day, no less.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Late? I didn't even know I was enrolled.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: No time for excuses. Your name, quickly, so I can mark you down.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: Now in you get, quickly! Straight through the gate, and don't dawdle.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Right. Through the gate it is, then.
